discord.title: Discord presence

status.searching: Can't find Discord — presence shows up once it's open.

discord.showLinksHint: The image opens the Discord server, the first line opens the repository.

storage.title: Board storage
storage.intro: What the app keeps for itself: pasted images, media from links, extracted frames, upscale results. Saving a .netsu project files them in the project folder; what stays here is only a copy, and freeing it loses nothing.
storage.failed: That didn't go through. Try again.
storage.archivedNotice: Board saved to “{{name}}”: its media now live in the project folder
storage.settlingHint: A file written moments ago may belong to an import the board has not placed yet. It will be checked on the next pass.

safe.title: Safe to free
safe.hint: Checked file by file: these files can be rebuilt, or already exist inside a project folder.
safe.cachesHint: Thumbnails and proxies. The app rebuilds them on demand.
safe.duplicated: Media already filed in a project ({{count}})
safe.duplicatedHint: The files are already in a project's folder, for example “{{project}}”.

sole.title: Save these somewhere first
sole.hint: These media exist nowhere else. Nothing here deletes them: save them first and they move to the section above.
sole.empty: Nothing at risk: everything the app keeps also exists elsewhere.
sole.sharedHint: A shared board has no project version: its document is authoritative and collaboration handles its media.
sole.openBoardHint: This board is open: use “Save as…” from its toolbar.
sole.orphansHint_one: {{count}} file · {{size}}. Nothing displays it anymore, but this is the only copy.
sole.orphansHint_other: {{count}} files · {{size}}. Nothing displays them anymore, but this is the only copy.
sole.sceneCount_one: {{count}} media file only the app holds · {{size}}
sole.sceneCount_other: {{count}} media files only the app holds · {{size}}

storage.footnote: Media you added from your own disk is never affected: the app only touches files it wrote itself.

device.title: This device
